Overview

The economics of Applied AI & GenAI for Banking & Financial Services flipped in the last two years: runtimes got durable, evaluation became routine, and orchestration frameworks matured into something you can run under change control. What separates winners now is integration discipline — how cleanly the capability plugs into core banking rails without inventing a shadow estate. In Banking & Financial Services the constraints are structural, not cosmetic: DORA operational resilience shapes what data may move, instant rails dominates the economics, and any capability that cannot explain its own decisions will be switched off by risk committees. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.
